title: J.D. LaRock:
title_short: J.D. · Not Even Ten Years Old
headline: Kids under ten pitched real business plans, so this education can start much earlier.
story: Alison asked for J.D.'s answer to: what gives you optimism about the future? Young people do, and the younger they are, the more optimistic. He saw children from kindergarten to fifth grade pitch like real entrepreneurs.
Open on the surprise: they don't even have two digits of age yet. Then why it matters: if this works so early, imagine what it can do. It must feel bright and optimistic.
